review.scope: Completed source proof/certificate/audit/replay claims carried as reported. No new Capital audit or execution; prior P2 transfer holds binding.

title: Reuse isolated data for a constrained pair query while charging the entire model campaign
statement: The source refined certificate selects a positive two-actuator operating window from the same retained probe and isolated measurements before deployment. Its favorable prediction coexists with a5.34x chemical-cost penalty and no installed-hardware saving.

evidence.range_scope: Predeployment pair certificate, actual carried-state run, separate statistics, complete chronological ledger and unfavorable chemical/hardware tradeoff.

evidence.quote: ## 4. The foundational consequence is a separation of local and global memory
evidence.range_scope: Constructed local/global memory separation, actual acquired versus analytic bounds and stronger direct-acquisition comparator with unexecuted protocol scope.
Reported completed audits/replay, source preservation and separately identifiable negative/positive/physical-cost results; originals unacquired.

requires: The SAME declared exclusion transport, defect, probe-memory and reproducible-source contract as the source local-memory certificate, plus the source retained intervention-composition bounds and simultaneous stationary-mean intervals.

Retained probe and isolated-control data only for the new pair certificate; earlier all-on and later pair observations are excluded from its selection. The actual saved native state and random-generator state continue at deployment.
provides: Executed model: 35 sites, four reservoir contacts, three installed source actuators and 31 unrefreshed bulk sites. Earlier conservative best-pair lower current bound -0.0702577935 failed. Sharper residual/tail bounds reused exactly the retained probe and isolated data; neither earlier all-on nor later pair observations entered the new certificate. Selected indices [0,2], physical sites [1,3], maximize the certified lower bound, not necessarily true current. Before deployment J was certified in [0.0356208652,0.5616139147] on a simultaneous 95% MODEL-confidence event.

The saved state and random-generator state continued from native time 750000 to 1000000. In 250000 time units there were 62500 output occupancy observations, 39578 occupied; the occupancy-based current estimate was0.266496 with held-out stationary interval [0.1962812354,0.3367107646]. Integrated net delivery was67046 particles, or0.268184 per time. Occupancy and transition-count statistics are distinct. The confidence event covers memory and stationary means, not a separate95% finite-time payback guarantee.

Chronological net qualified product: boundary probe0 credited; baseline -67440; sources1/2/3 alone -13232/-12854/-13303; three-source production +142573; later pair +67046; total +102790. The probe earns no product credit but its signed chemical transfers remain paid. Complete campaign:1000000 native time units,35000000 site-time units,1000000 scalar occupancy reads,50264 contact/gate setting changes and87020434 graphical events including null events. Inventory35 initial/20 final, no final reset. Signed chemical input above background4340703.274141kBT, or42.2288478854kBT per net qualified particle; source reports closure with product exergy, medium heat and endpoint inventory.

Three-source production used4.61567kBT chemical input per net particle; the pair used24.64874kBT, a5.34x penalty. The inactive source stayed connected to the background bath and drained290991 particles. All three actuators and four baseline contacts remained installed, and earlier phases used all three sources. The last window limits simultaneous added-birth actuation; it establishes neither installed-hardware nor energy saving.

For one already specified operating setting, direct acquisition is cheaper and yields a stronger interval. After the same boundary probe, the declared direct all-on protocol needs200000 native time units and125000 scalar reads versus reusable acquisition500000 time units/500000 reads before first deployment. That comparator protocol was NOT separately executed. Without a penalty on source enabling, all-on is already optimal by monotonicity. The earned gain is reuse for a later constrained pair query, not one-target speed or historical priority. Existing single-trajectory learning/mixing certificates and absorbing-walk/exclusion machinery remain prior inputs. The suggested functional-inequalities source still uses full stationary conditionals in its Eq.50; this route accepts narrower transport structure/local targets instead of supplying those conditionals.
assumptions: The95% model-confidence event covers memory and stationary means; realized particle delivery is not a separate95% finite-time payback guarantee. Selection maximizes the lower certificate, not necessarily true current.

Occupancy-derived current and integrated transition count are separate finite-run statistics. The failed conservative lower bound remains a real earlier failure, not overwritten by the refined result.

The direct comparator resource protocol was not separately executed. Without a source-enable penalty, monotonicity already favors all-on. The benefit is reuse under a later simultaneous-actuation constraint.
costs: Detector energy, switching work, clocks, computation, erasure, fabrication, external reservoir preparation and final reset remain unpriced. No conversion of model time/site count to seconds/fabricated area is supplied. Physical implementation remains unresolved; no complete-device efficiency or industrial-throughput claim follows.

All three actuators and four baseline contacts remain installed. Earlier phases use all sources. Native time/site counts have no supplied physical time/area conversion. Probe transfers are charged despite zero credited product.
Chemical product exergy, medium heat and changed final inventory close the source model ledger, not complete-device thermodynamic costs. No final reset is performed.
